page.notes: Greek words in the first paragraph are uncertain: ῥαχάβ and the forms ἔξς and ἠσαιδ are read from a faint scan. The Hebrew finals line and the numbers 500 to 900 are clear, but the Hebrew letter groups before them are not legible enough to copy, so they are marked illegible. The Hebrew word after "ut" in the millennia sentence (אג) and the letters before "3500" are doubtful. The Hebrew in "ut אג" may be misread. The "ו" of the page is faint in places. The catchword SECT. is the start of the next section.
